Olga — quick summary from SRE after initial triage (will pull raw traces and a longer bundle for QA shortly):

What we saw
- Elevated 5xx rate in the model serving gateway between 09:08:15-09:42:05 UTC (equivalent to the 02:08-02:42 PT reported window).
- Root proximate cause: a checkpoint token invalidation in pool rwd-pool-6 triggered a cascade of KV cache misses and retry storms across a subset of hosts.
- Impact classification: regional availability degradation affecting ~3.4% of requests for that window (matches Greenline volume distribution).

Evidence we will produce
- ingress request logs with request ids (compressed tar: raw_traces_20280502.tar.gz)
- per-host 5xx counters and CPU/GPU utilization charts for rwd-pool-6
- KV cache hit/miss timeline and eviction trace snippets

SLA classification & provisional stance
- Based on the current telemetry this looks eligible for a proportional remedy under section 4.2 of our SLA (region-level availability).
- For speed, recommend offering a provisional credit equal to 12% of the affected hour's usage for the customer — we can refine after full RCA.

Next steps
1) I'll assemble a full evidence bundle and timeline by EOD PT and share the Drive link.
2) Recommend we offer a provisional credit form to Greenline so we can close their immediate billing concern; final credit will be adjusted after the RCA.
3) Diego and I will schedule the postmortem (SRE + PM + Eng + CS) — propose Fri 2028-05-04 10:00 PT.

I'll attach the traces once the export completes (running now).

-David
David Kim
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Hi Julie — thank you for the report and for attaching the request IDs. We take incidents like this seriously and wanted to confirm next steps while our team completes the RCA.

What we can confirm now
- Redwood observed a regional availability degradation during 2028-05-02 09:08:15–09:42:05 UTC (02:08–02:42 PT).
- Impact: ~3.4% of requests in your traffic distribution were affected; source telemetry aligns to your sample IDs.

Provisional remedy and timeline
- We've prepared a provisional credit offer equal to 12% of usage for the impacted hour (form attached: provisional_credit_form.pdf). This is provisional and will be finalized once the RCA completes.
- Postmortem: we've scheduled an internal RCA + joint review for Fri, 2028-05-04 at 10:00 PT. We'll invite your ops lead for a 30-minute sync if you'd like — please confirm availability.

Evidence and deliverables
- We will share a trace bundle and ingress logs in a shared Drive by EOD PT (link: https://drive.redwood/example/greenline-0502-traces).
- The full RCA (root cause, corrective actions, mitigations, and timelines) will be delivered within 5 business days.

Temporary mitigations we're applying
- Pinned rwd-pool-6 to the newer checkpoint handling branch to prevent token invalidations during warmup.
- Added short-term KV cache resiliency gating to reduce retry amplification during startup flaps.

If you'd like us to initiate the provisional credit now, please sign the attached credit form and return (or let us know and we can route through your procurement contact). We'll keep communication open and share the RCA as soon as it's available.

Apologies for the disruption and thanks for working with us to resolve this.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Director, Customer Escalations
Redwood Inference
